Name: My Cuter Farm Animals
Author: Wurstmagnet
Description:
I just wanted to share my edited Farm Animals. 


[color=#ffd966][size=3][b]Added a Content Patcher Version of my Mod. 
[/b][/size][/color]You need [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher [/url]﻿from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/1552317]Pathoschild[/url]﻿ to run the CP Version.


[b][u]How to Install (CP Version)
[/u][/b]
Download via Vortex or Download manually and place the folder (inside the.zip file) into your Mods folder located at [i]Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods[/i] or[i] [/i][i]GOG Galaxy\Games\Stardew Valley\Mods[/i].



[b][u]How to Install (Classic File)

[/u][/b]1. Backup your original .xnb files (BabyGoat.xnb, BabyPig.xnb, BabySheep.xnb, Brown Chicken.xnb, Blue Chicken.xnb, Goat.xnb,
    Pig.xnb, ShearedSheep.xnb, Sheep.xnb, Viod Chicken.xnb, White Chicken.xnb) located at Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Content\Animals,
    GOG Galaxy\Games\Stardew Valley\Content\Animals or your custom Game Location
2. Extract the .rar and put the new .xnb files at the location above and overwrite the original ones
3. Start Stardew Valley and enjoy your new animals!


Includes .png files if you prefer to use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2095]DIYCP Animals[/url] instead of replacing .xnb files :)



The cow textures I am using:  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/33228995]Chrysanthe[/url] - [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/224?tab=files]Harvest Moon Cow Replacement[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1119]Brown Harvest Moon Cows[/url]﻿ recolor by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/44000237]bluestarkiller[/url]
